name: node-analytics
description: Audience Signal — a Node on GROUNDED. Owned-data audience-resonance analytics for an investigative newsroom.
comment_hostedDependencies: Only server-hosted.js (online multi-tenant mode) uses express/multer/cookie-parser/jsonwebtoken/pg/@anthropic-ai/sdk. pdf-parse + word-extractor are used by BOTH modes for .pdf / legacy .doc uploads (imported lazily; a .docx-only install never loads them). All optional so a flaky build of one can never break a newsroom's local install.
